verdict.line: You lose if you trade into a live Counter Strike (E) or stand through his third empowered auto; you win the instant his E is spent and you commit with your full combo.

brief.thesis: Jax's E (Counter Strike) is a single-charge dodge-into-stun that hard-counters short Camille all-ins, which is why he holds both the lane and solo-kill edge across 761 games even though the overall win rate sits at a near-even 48.4%. Camille isn't equipped to win a straight brawl into a live E — she's built to poke with W's cone damage and reset with Hookshot until that charge is burned, at which point her double-cast Q and lockdown kit win the fight outright.

theirWindow.what: He will bait a step-in with a half-approach, dodge your first hit, and stun-punish into a full trade. Do not extend Q into melee range here — hold max-range W poke and back off if he walks up.

yourWindow.when: his E is on cooldown or just used
yourWindow.what: Commit immediately: double-cast Q (Precision Protocol) for the true damage proc, then E (Hookshot) to lock the range down. This is the only window where your all-in beats his without item lead.

start.why: At 49.8% WR over 307 games it outperforms Doran's Blade here (46.1%) — the extra sustain against Jax's poke and early all-in threat matters more than the marginal damage in a lane where he holds solo-kill advantage.

boots.why: 49.7% WR over 575 games and 71.5% pick — flattens the bonus magic damage from his Grandmaster's Might empowered auto and the on-hit true damage from Grand Challenge (R) in extended trades.

core.why: Highest-WR path start (58.9% over 168 games) — the burst-plus-mobility proc is what lets you actually win the fight the moment his E is spent.
Wave clear to convert your post-6 lane lead into side-lane pressure and reset faster after all-ins.
The 42.9%-pick, 58.9%-WR third item — sustains you through his Grand Challenge true damage window instead of losing extended trades post-6.

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp's proc-and-heal on your first auto per fight matches Jax's early durability and offsets his poke damage across the many short trades this matchup forces before level 6.

summoners.why: Teleport+Ignite is the highest measured win rate at 50.5%, even though it's only run in 12.1% of games. Ignite converts the burst window right after you bait out his E into an actual kill instead of a shove, and Teleport lets you skip the weak levels 1-5 waves and reset straight into your 9-13 split-push spike once Trinity Force completes.

playing.title: Bait E before you commit
playing.detail: Threaten a Q from just outside his dash range to force Counter Strike (E) early. If he doesn't take it, disengage back to W poke instead of trading into a live dodge-stun.

playing.title: Poke with max-range W
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep (W) deals bonus damage at the outer edge of the cone — stand at max range so both hits connect without stepping into his auto-attack threat range.

playing.title: Track his passive stacks
playing.detail: Grandmaster's Might empowers his third auto with bonus magic damage and attack speed. Disengage before that third hit lands in any extended trade, especially after level 6.

playing.title: All-in only once E is spent
playing.detail: The moment Counter Strike is on cooldown, commit fully with a double-cast Q for the true damage proc followed immediately by Hookshot (E) to lock him in range.

playing.title: Don't open with R
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum traps him in the zone but doesn't stop him casting a still-available E. Save it for right after he's already burned Counter Strike, not as your engage tool.

playing.title: Respect Grand Challenge post-6
playing.detail: His ultimate grants on-hit true damage and attack speed for extended fights. Don't stand and trade past 3-4 seconds once it's active — disengage and re-engage instead of holding the trade.

playing.title: Convert with Teleport post-Trinity
playing.detail: Once Trinity Force completes, use Hookshot to a wall for long-range engages or split-push and Teleport back to punish overextensions elsewhere on the map.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own analysis layered on top of that data.
